article.hook: Someone says one thing while their eyes tell another. The story is too big to fit in words, and the space between is filled with something you can’t name yet - that’s Neptune in Pisces moving through the sky. It’s a long turn, measured in years, where what we feel outpaces what we can say aloud.
article.lived: Neptune slips into the background of our days for about fourteen years, softening the borders between self and other. We catch ourselves pausing mid-conversation, pulled toward a melody or image that feels like a secret message meant only for us. Collective creativity rises in flashes - murals bloom on city walls, songs take on a strange urgency - but so do moments when reality blurs, and the line between help and avoidance gets messy.
article.turn: That longing to dissolve boundaries often becomes a fog that lets problems drift without direction. Idealism turns into pretending, and compassion slides into enabling. The trick is to notice when your care is a veil for not facing the hard parts. Stop floating in the haze and name what you’re covering up - no one else will do it for you.
